mapper.delete: delete from t_user_grade where u_id = #{userId} and g_id = #{gradeId}
mapper.select: select ug.u_id from t_user_grade ug inner join t_user u on u.id = ug.u_id where ug.g_id = #{gradeId} and u.role_id = 2 and (u.is_deleted = 0 or u.is_deleted is null) and (ug.is_deleted = 0 or ug.is_deleted is null)

select u.id, u.user_name as userName, u.real_name as realName from t_user_grade ug inner join t_user u on u.id = ug.u_id where ug.g_id = #{gradeId} and u.role_id = 2 and (u.is_deleted = 0 or u.is_deleted is null) and (ug.is_deleted = 0 or ug.is_deleted is null) order by u.id asc

select distinct g_id from ( select ug.g_id as g_id from t_user_grade ug where ug.u_id = #{userId} and (ug.is_deleted = 0 or ug.is_deleted is null) union select u.grade_id as g_id from t_user u where u.id = #{userId} and u.grade_id is not null ) t where g_id is not null
